<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 194.0862 likely corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈193.07895 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈13 % M+1, ≈33 % M+2) suggests ~12 carbons and one chlorine atom. A formula C₁₂H₁₄Cl matches the exact mass (193.07840 Da, Δ≈0.6 mDa) and the observed isotopic distribution. No oxygen atoms are required, so O count is zero. The required format is CxHyOzX, giving C12H14O0Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H14O0Cl</final_answer>
